Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and the deadline. Short answers up front and a recommended minimal bundle below. Attaching a one-page summary + bridge-letter sample.

Transfer options (choose one):
- Standard: SOC 2 Type II PDF + bridge letter via S3 presigned URLs (48h expiry).
- Alternate: Secure Box folder (view-only, limited to registered email addresses).
- Auditor access: temporary, read-only S3 role for your auditor (requires name/email + auditor firm).

Minimal prioritized evidence bundle (recommended initial package — quick procurement pass):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — full dated report.
2) Bridge letter (if request window mismatch) — we can provide a short bridge letter that explains coverage and dates.
3) System descriptions + control matrix (concise 2–3 page extract).
4) User access/privilege matrix (high level).
5) Log sample (anonymized) or retention policy + log retention statement.
6) Change control snapshot (recent release notes + approval trace).

Redaction guidance: we can redact internal identifiers and customer names on request. If you prefer hashed telemetry instead of raw logs we'll accept that for initial review.

Timeline: if you confirm preferred transfer method by EOD Mon 2025-04-21 we can deliver the prioritized bundle by 2025-05-02.

Hi Olivia — short answers to your questions and action items below.

- Redacted logs: Yes — hashed or redacted log samples are acceptable for initial procurement review. We will remove customer identifiers and any PII before delivery.
- Transfer method: presigned S3 URLs are typically easiest for us and minimize manual packaging; Box can be used if your procurement requires a managed folder. We will mark files as read-only and enable link expiry.
- DPA/NDA: We prefer a signed DPA before transferring any live log samples. For the report PDF and non-sensitive control artifacts we can share on a fast track while DPA is processing. If you send a counter-signed DPA, we will include the log sample in the package.

Action items and timeline:
1) Procurement picks transfer method (S3 presigned or Box) — reply by 2025-04-21.
2) If auditor access is required, provide auditor name/email and firm; otherwise we will use presigned URLs.
3) If you need a signed DPA prior to logs, please route to legal; we can deliver the report + bridge letter immediately and hold logs until DPA is complete.

I've attached a minimal evidence checklist you can attach to your vendor packet and a bridge-letter sample for your legal. For convenience, I've added a DocuSign link for our standard DPA and included our HubSpot deal link in case you want to reference the procurement ticket.
